name: shipping-api
description: Example API: a GraphQL subgraph that adds shipment data to the orders. It extends the Order entity of the orders-api brick and keeps its own data in PostgreSQL. With an oidc provider it asks every request for a token that carries the client role shipping:read (queries) or shipping:write (mutations) (D22). Its source is apis/shipping-api; build the image with: docker build -t ghcr.io/rudney5000/plugbricks/shipping-api:0.1.0 apis/shipping-api
